title: ClearingPeriodResponse
description: A [Clearing Period](/api-reference/settlement-management/models/clearing-period) representing one settlement month for a balance group.

bilanzierungsmonat.description: First day of the settlement month in ISO 8601 format.
bilanzierungsmonat.title: Bilanzierungsmonat

created_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this clearing period was created.
created_ts.title: Created Ts

final_deadline.description: Final billing deadline (M+42 WT) as ISO 8601 datetime.
final_deadline.title: Final Deadline

last_modified_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the most recent modification.
last_modified_ts.title: Last Modified Ts

objection_deadline.description: Objection window closing deadline (M+30 WT) as ISO 8601 datetime.
objection_deadline.title: Objection Deadline

org_uid.description: Organization that owns this clearing period.
org_uid.title: Org Uid

preliminary_deadline.description: Preliminary billing deadline (M+18 WT) as ISO 8601 datetime.
preliminary_deadline.title: Preliminary Deadline

total_imbalance_cost_eur.description: Total imbalance cost in EUR based on reBAP prices.
total_imbalance_cost_eur.title: Total Imbalance Cost Eur

total_imbalance_mwh.description: Total imbalance energy in MWh across all settlement days.
total_imbalance_mwh.title: Total Imbalance Mwh

uid.description: Unique identifier for this clearing period.
uid.title: Uid
